name: model-optimisation-phone
description: One glTF/GLB in, one optimised GLB out that desktop and phone both load and that looks identical, with pixel-measured proof.

scripts.example: echo 'Download FlightHelmet/glTF from github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets into example/source/, then:' && node starter/optimise.mjs example/source/FlightHelmet.gltf example/models/flight-helmet.glb --budget 14MB --report example/report.json
